component.name: Nida
نداء
component.summary: Prayer time notification and adhan player

description.p: Nida (نداء) is a desktop prayer time application that sits in your system tray.

ul.li: Automatic prayer time calculation via aladhan.com API
Adhan audio playback at prayer times
Automatic media pause/resume (MPRIS on Linux, Win32 on Windows)
Multiple calculation methods (MWL, ISNA, Umm Al-Qura, etc.)

description.p: Major stability update: fixed offline cache, single-instance IPC, autostart handling, media pause/resume, and reproducible AppImage builds on Ubuntu 22.04.
